summary: Understand the reviewed schedule sources available for personal activity planning.

facts.title: Use Care Calendar
facts.message: Open Care Calendar from your dashboard to view supported saved Offering schedules and your personal plans. Saving an Offering does not guarantee it has a supported schedule to show in Care Calendar, and a personal plan is not a provider booking or registration. Review source changes before relying on dates, and confirm attendance with the provider. Unsaving an Offering in My Directory can remove its saved calendar source.
